newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Cretacico area to be re-auctioned Friday.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Cretacico area to be re-auctioned Friday.

text.p: Venezuela's Cretacico Sur oil area, which received no bids on Wednesday, will be re-auctioned Friday, the last day of operating contracts sales, Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) vice-president Luis Urdaneta said.
"We're going to offer Cretacico Sur half-an-hour after the auction of the last field (Boqueron)," he told reporters.
PDVSA exploration and production coordinator Juan Szabo said, after the area received no bids, that its size and geological complexity had probably put off investors.
The 784-square km field, discovered in the center of Lake Maracaibo in 1967, currently produces 500 barrels per day fron one active well and has 30-50 million barrels of proven reserves.
